result.description: A fictional tabletop workflow console built for collaborative game-night campaign planning, featuring modular scene cards, integrated initiative tracking, and a dry-erase command surface. It is designed for organizing adventures, not for computing or data storage, and includes color-coded slots for rules references, character notes, and session objectives. The device emphasizes portability, analog interaction, and narrative coordination for small creative teams.
result.title: NebulaForge Orchestrator Console
